$comment: Binds the PII qualification identity and the PII code changed since it to the hand-written status table in docs/reference/detection.md (issue #1186). The statuses themselves are read from the pinned support matrix (benchmarks/support-matrix.json piiFamilies, piiQualification, piiDistribution; redact-secret/redact-secret-benchmarks#647). Checked by scripts/check-pii-family-status.py, which fails when a shipped PII family has no matrix row, when the page disagrees with the matrix, or when the matrix names a different qualification. The statuses are the Beta.11 qualification and are not re-qualified on a later core commit.
